verdict.rationale: The evidence strongly implies an official Python SDK, though it never names one. The docs show Python code using a Pydantic `BaseModel` for structured extraction, reference a live `observe()` call alongside CLI and generated workflow code, and describe sessions controlled programmatically. The GitHub repo pairs scripting with AI agents, and a Bearer-authenticated REST API backs it all. Missing for 10: an explicitly named and documented official SDK (Python and/or TypeScript) with install instructions and a reference, multi-language coverage, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
